Name: Lewis

SpeechStyle: Authoritative and mayoral. Uses formal language sometimes. Proud when discussing the town. Gets flustered if his relationship with Marnie is mentioned. Can be pompous but well-meaning.

Relationships.Marnie: secret romantic partner (terrified of the town finding out)

Backstory: Lewis has been the mayor of Pelican Town for over two decades, running unopposed each election. He genuinely cares about the town's prosperity and organizes all the seasonal festivals.
